description: Source code for AC4 media extractor parser, including classes AC4Parser and AC4DSIParser, with functions for parsing AC4 stream descriptors, language tags, substream configurations, and related data structures.

classes.name: AC4Parser
classes.description: Main parser class for AC4 streams.

classes.name: AC4DSIParser
classes.description: Parser class for AC4 stream descriptor information, handling detailed parsing of substreams, language tags, and configurations.

methods.name: AC4DSIParser::parseLanguageTag
methods.description: Parses language tag from bitstream and assigns it to presentation.

methods.name: AC4DSIParser::parseSubstreamDSI
methods.description: Parses substream descriptor information including channel mode, content type, and language indicator.

methods.name: AC4DSIParser::parseSubstreamGroupDSI
methods.description: Parses group descriptor information for substreams, including substream presence, channel coding, and content classification.

methods.name: AC4DSIParser::parseBitrateDsi
methods.description: Parses bitrate information from the bitstream.

methods.name: AC4DSIParser::parse
methods.description: Main function to parse the entire AC4 descriptor stream, handling multiple presentation configurations and substream structures.
